claims.text: The PMO public notice of 16 September 2019 announces His Majesty's Cabinet's decisions 'in honour of the late Prime Minister of Tonga, The Honourable Samuela 'Akilisi Pohiva': the cortege arriving at Fua'amotu on Tuesday 17 September 2019 at 3pm, lying in state until the morning of 19 September, the flag at half-mast and a Public Holiday and National Day of Mourning on Thursday 19 September 2019, the funeral service at the Centenary Church at 10am, and interment at Telekava Cemetery.
claims.uncertainty: Funeral and mourning arrangements only. The notice does not give the date of death.
